title: LongForge: Measuring and Improving Long-Context Instruction Data via Evidence-Assertion Reasoning Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing quality control for long-context instruction-tuning data is a one-shot judgment inside the generation pipeline that leaves only a scalar, revealing neither which document parts an answer uses nor how many reasoning steps it writes down; the data can thus be neither audited nor controlled. We formalize data quality as a property of the alignment structure among document, question, and answer, and build LongForge, which pairs an analyzer that measures long-context data with a synthesizer that generates it. The analyzer reverse-reconstructs each sample into an evidence-assertion reasoning graph and programmatically computes four dimensions on it: breadth, depth, correctness, and completeness. Every reading traces back to specific evidence spans and reasoning steps, making data auditable. translated_title: LongForge：基于证据-断言推理图的长上下文指令数据测量与改进
translated_abstract: 现有针对长上下文指令微调数据的质量控制，是生成流水线中的一次性判断，只留下一个标量值，既不揭示答案使用了文档的哪些部分，也不揭示它写下了多少推理步骤，因此数据既无法被审计也无法被控制。我们将数据质量形式化为文档、问题和答案之间对齐结构的一种属性，并构建了LongForge，它将测量长上下文数据的分析器与生成此类数据的合成器配对。分析器将每个样本反向重构为证据-断言推理图，并在此基础上以程序化方式计算四个维度：广度、深度、正确性和完整性。每一次解读都可追溯到具体的证据片段和推理步骤，从而使数据可被审计。对七个主流数据集的测量揭示了两个此前从未被量化的缺陷：广度几乎不随文档长度增长，而深度通常（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出LongForge框架，将数据质量形式化为文档-问题-答案之间的对齐结构，通过将样本反向重构为证据-断言推理图，从广度、深度、正确性、完整性四个维度实现对长上下文指令数据的可审计测量与改进。
en_tdlr: LongForge formalizes data quality as the alignment structure among document, question, and answer, reverse-reconstructing samples into evidence-assertion reasoning graphs to auditably measure and improve long-context instruction data across breadth, depth, correctness, and completeness.
